name: Audiobookshelf
description: Listen to audiobooks and podcasts from your Audiobookshelf server, with the screen off or while you play games.
author: ExpandedPlum

changelog.v0.1.0: First release: streaming, downloads, chapters, speed, sleep timer, screen-off and in-game playback.
changelog.v0.2.0: Podcasts, series, authors, collections, playlists, bookmarks, API-key and phone (QR) sign-in.
